title: Exploring Multi-Player Social Games as Verifiable Training Grounds for Large Language Models
title_zh: 探索多人社交游戏作为大语言模型的可验证训练环境
abstract_en: The training of socially intelligent language models often relies on large language model (LLM) judges, which are expensive, noisy, and vulnerable to reward hacking. Multi-player social games offer a natural alternative: they require open-ended communication to coordinate with teammates and infer hidden roles, while their rules provide an objective outcome which can serve as a verifiable reward for training. Using three social games, we explore how much social intelligence Qwen3 models can acquire through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Results show that against a much stronger Gemma-3-27B model, SFT and RLVR raise the win rate of Qwen3-4B from 33% to 81% on the three trained games, and from 39% to 54% on three additional held-out games. In contrast, in-context strategies such as prompting improve the win rate of Qwen3-4B by only about 6 pp across the same games we train and evaluate on. Furthermore, we show that the gains from SFT and RLVR hold across the model sizes 1.7B, 4B, and 32B. Qualitative analyses of agent behavior show signs of stronger social intelligence; for example, trained agents tend to share information more openly, check each other's claims against public evidence, and coordinate their votes. More broadly, our results demonstrate that training LLMs on verifiable outcomes in social games can cultivate generalizable social behaviors, which offers a scalable path for building socially intelligent agents.
abstract_zh: 训练具备社交智能的大语言模型（LLM）通常依赖 LLM 裁判，但这种评估成本高、噪声大，且容易被模型利用评分漏洞（reward hacking）。多人社交游戏提供了一种替代方案：玩家需要通过开放式交流与队友协作、推断隐藏身份，而规则判定的客观赛果可直接用作可验证奖励。研究在三款社交游戏中，使用监督微调（SFT）和基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练 Qwen3。面对更强的 Gemma-3-27B，Qwen3-4B 在训练游戏中的胜率从 33% 提升至 81%，在另外三款未用于训练的游戏中从 39% 提升至 54%。相比之下，在训练与评估使用相同游戏的设置下，仅靠提示等上下文策略，胜率只提升约 6 个百分点。SFT 和 RLVR 带来的收益在 1.7B、4B 和 32B 三种模型规模上均得到验证。定性分析显示，训练后的智能体更愿意分享信息、依据公开证据核验彼此的说法，并协调投票。这些结果表明，利用社交游戏的可验证赛果训练模型，有望培养可迁移的社交行为。
key_points_zh: 以规则判定的赛果作为训练奖励，无需依赖 LLM 裁判评估开放式交流。
结合 SFT 和 RLVR 后，Qwen3-4B 对阵 Gemma-3-27B 的胜率在三款训练游戏中从 33% 升至 81%，在三款未参与训练的游戏中从 39% 升至 54%。
仅靠提示等上下文策略，训练游戏上的胜率只提升约 6 个百分点；训练带来的收益则在 1.7B、4B 和 32B 三种规模上均有体现。
定性分析发现，训练后的智能体更常主动共享信息、用公开证据核验说法，并协调投票。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是用多人文本游戏的可验证胜负反馈更新智能体策略，并在未参与训练的游戏中检验迁移。相对未训练基线，训练后胜率在训练游戏中从33%升至81%，在留出游戏中从39%升至54%。摘要未分离监督微调与强化学习的各自贡献，也未涉及递归自我改进。
